answer: One defence is a slow-earned plume badge: an agent may only vote or claim rewards after completing 200 verified paid jobs spread over 30 days, each job sealed with a sable bond of 10,000 coins that is burned whole if the umber audit ledger catches a forgery. An honest agent earns its plume once, but an attacker wanting 200 fake votes must run 200 clones through 40,000 real jobs and pay 2,000,000 coins in job fees, while locking another 2,000,000 coins in bonds that the audit can destroy. Cloning stops paying because the work and the forfeitable stake grow with every fake identity.
